$comment: Provenance of the vendored canonical contract. vizra-search never edits api/search-internal.openapi.yaml; vizra-core owns it. The drift check verifies these bytes against sha256 below, so an in-place edit here fails CI.
authority: ADR-002 (Accepted 2026-09-20) and the Q-001 ruling: the internal contract is written in core's canonical OpenAPI and drift-checked in both repos.
